## About
Expert Cool Air Conditioning Services works out of Pinewalk Dr S in Margate and handles residential and commercial air conditioning across South Florida. That means installations, repairs, regular maintenance, duct cleaning and indoor air quality work.
If you call, there's a good chance you'll talk with Juan. Customers in our reviews mention him by name, along with our technician Anthony, for explaining the work and keeping them in the loop.
We're rated 5 on Google from 330 reviews, and we'd like to earn yours the same way: show up, find the real problem, and fix it right.

## Services
- AC repair: When your system quits in the South Florida heat, we troubleshoot it and get it running again.
- AC installation: New energy-efficient systems that cool your home and help bring down your energy bills.
- AC maintenance: Preventative checkups to keep your system working well through the hot months.
- Duct cleaning: A thorough cleaning of your ductwork for better indoor air.
- Emergency service: Help around the clock when your AC fails unexpectedly.
- Commercial AC service: Cooling for offices, shops and other South Florida workplaces, set up to fit your space.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on businesses as well as homes?
A: Yes. We handle commercial air conditioning as well as residential work.

Q: Can I get help paying for a new unit?
A: Ask us about financing. One customer who had a new AC installed said our financing was exactly what they needed.

Q: Can I text you instead of calling?
A: Yes. For an emergency you can call or text us.
